description: Dutch vegetable and soft-fruit breeding company. Fruitnet reports it opened a new facility in the Dutch soft-fruit heartland around Breda to enhance its berry breeding R&D, covering blueberry, strawberry, raspberry and blackberry -- a genuine cross-berry breeding operation, not a single-crop program.
